# Alpha Speed AI

> Alpha Speed AI is a Dallas-Fort Worth AI automation studio. We design, build, and operate AI agents for small and mid-sized businesses — lead follow-up, scheduling, customer chat, and back-office workflows — behind AgentVault, a governance layer with approval gates, audit logs, and MCP connectors.

Keep this file in sync with src/lib/seoRoutes.ts (every indexable route should be reachable from here). Convention: https://llmstxt.org/
